name: AppFlowy-MinIO
description: Step 3/7: MinIO S3-compatible object storage for AppFlowy Cloud file uploads, attachments, and collaboration snapshots. Part of the AppFlowy Cloud stack.

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Persistent storage for all MinIO buckets and objects.

ports.name: MinIO Console Port
ports.description: MinIO web console port — accessible from your browser.

ports.name: MinIO API Port (internal)
ports.description: MinIO S3 API port — used internally by AppFlowy services. No host port needed unless you need direct S3 access.

variables.name: Root User (Access Key)
variables.description: MinIO root username / S3 access key. Change this for production.

variables.name: Root Password (Secret Key)
variables.description: MinIO root password / S3 secret key. Change this for production. Must match APPFLOWY_S3_SECRET_KEY in other services.

variables.name: Browser Redirect URL
variables.description: Public URL for the MinIO web console. Set to http://YOUR_SERVER_IP/minio (or your domain).
